name: What's This Block?
description: What every odd ore and stone you mine is for.

pages.title: What's This Block?
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Every odd ore or stone you dig up has a use, listed here
- Many coloured stones **crush** into metal or powder
- **Zinc** has no best depth: look in caves
- **Andesite** sits below about Y 60

Mining turns up a lot of blocks from different mods. Most are either a metal ore or a stone that a [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing Wheel](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() turns into something useful. The rest are building stone.\
\
JEI shows recipes for what a block **drops**, so look up the drop, not the ore block.

pages.title: Finding Zinc
pages.text: Y -63 to 70, spread evenly, about as common as iron. No depth is better, so caves anywhere from Y -60 to 60 are the best place to look. Blue **asurine** also crushes to zinc.

pages.title: Finding Andesite
pages.text: Terralith keeps andesite out of hillsides. It forms big patches below about Y 60. Or craft it: diorite plus cobblestone makes two. Diorite is common around Y 0 to 30.

pages.title: Nitrate
pages.text: Drops from Nitrate Ore. Smelt it, blow a fan through powder snow onto it, then [#](2E5AAC)[mix](entry://glossary/mixing)[#]() it with ice into **Liquid Nitrogen**. A reactor cooled with it handles four times the heat water can. [#](2E5AAC)[Nuclear](entry://industry/nuclear)[#]()

pages.title: Raw Thorium
pages.text: Drops from Thorium Ore. It can't be smelted: crush it to dust, mix that into fluid and compact it into ingots for Thorium Rods. [#](2E5AAC)[Nuclear](entry://industry/nuclear)[#]()

pages.title: Stones that give metal
pages.text:
Create's striated stones [#](2E5AAC)[crush](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() into metal:
- **Crimsite** (red): iron
- **Veridium** (green): copper
- **Ochrum** (yellow): gold
- **Asurine** (blue): zinc

TFMG's **galena** crushes to lead. Each gives a little per block.

pages.title: Stones that give powder
pages.text:
From TFMG:
- **Bauxite**: bauxite powder, the start of aluminum
- **Lignite**: coal when crushed
- **Fireclay**: drops fireclay balls that smelt into Fireproof Bricks for the [#](2E5AAC)[blast furnace](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]()

Nether **sulfur** crushes to sulfur dust.

pages.title: Building stone
pages.text:
These are mostly for building, with stonecutter shapes:
- **Scoria** and **scorchia** (Create)
- **Limestone**: also crushes to TFMG limesand
- **Autunite** (Create Nuclear)
- Tuff, calcite, dripstone

Cut or polished limestone crushes to nitrate and lead.

pages.title: Other ores
pages.text:
Lead, uranium, nickel, lithium, platinum and mithril ores smelt or crush like any metal. Depths and uses: [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Guide](entry://materials/ore_guide)[#]().\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Crushed nickel has no washing recipe; smelt it.
